title: Hybrid event on-call expense journal
content:
Notes to self — running point while on-call for hybrid event (short, messy, use as working checklist)

Quick summary:
- Covering: venue ops + on-site vendor liaison + expense capture for team of 6 (2 days).
- Primary contact for receipts and preapproval: travel-ops@redwood.com (cc finance@redwood.com).
- Use Ramp for all card charges, tag expenses to project: EVENTS-RED-2026.

Pre-departure (48–72h):
- Confirm final headcount and dietary notes with catering (see vendor section).
- Upload flight + hotel itinerary to Concur/Ramp and Slack #events. Quick link: https://app.ramp.com/expenses (use company card if vendor requires immediate charge).
- Verify per-diem rules in Confluence: business meals only, alcohol allowed only with client approval; cap $75/person/day unless preapproved.
- Print paper copies: boarding passes, hotel reservation, 1 vendor SLA copy. Take photo backup of each receipt immediately after purchase (phone camera + upload to Ramp).
- Confirm evening on-call rotation: Liam -> night 1, Rita -> night 2. Add to calendar.

On-site logistics checklist (day-of):
- Arrival: check-in with venue contact (name: Priya Mehta, operations lead). Get on-site Wi-Fi passphrase and hospitality room key.
- Shipping: confirm pickup of swag crate — tracking # on DHL label in Drive folder.
- Badge printer: test with sample names (badge supplies in Ops kit).
- AV: ask for HDMI adapters / clicker / spare lapel mic. Take photo of AV rack once live.

Expense capture rules (quick reference):
- Use company card where possible. If paying out of pocket: scan receipts and submit within 7 days. No receipt -> explain in memo + attach bank statement line (limited acceptance).
- Meals: itemize attendees when submitting (names/companies). Use meal template text below.
- Misc: parking, last-minute supplies (tape, gaffer, extension cords) — tag as "on-site supplies".
- Taxis / rideshare: prefer rideshares; include trip receipt and screenshot of route. International mileage: record kilometers + conversion rate.

Vendor contacts (quick dial/save):
- Venue ops: Priya Mehta — +1 415-555-0123 — priya@bayconvention.com — 900 Market St, San Francisco, CA.
- Catering: GoodBite Events — Sales: Marco Ruiz — +1 415-555-0789 — marco@goodbite.co — day-of lead: Tasha +1 415-555-0790. Special note: gluten-free boxed meals reserved under code REDWOOD-BOX.
- AV company: ClearSound AV — Dispatch +1 415-555-0456 — tech@clearsoundav.io (on-call tech: Joel).
- Badge/print: FastTags — +1 888-FAST-TAG (ext 2) — rush fee $45 if under 4 hrs.

Emergency / backup plans:
- Lost receipts: take photo of bank card statement line + short memo (who/what/why). Finance accepts this for <$75 items; larger amounts need manager sign-off.
- Vendor no-show: escalate to venue contact first; if unresolved in 30 min, get on-call SRE to switch room schedule (TRVL-342 linked ticket).
- Flight delay: use corporate travel insurance (policy # TR-2024-CORE) — contact travel-insure@redwood.ai.

Post-conference (24–72h):
- Collect receipts from all teammates. Create single zipped folder per person: receipts + brief memo per expense. Upload to Ramp and tag with project code EVENTS-RED-2026.
- Quick expense memo template (copy/paste into Ramp notes):
  "Date: YYYY-MM-DD | Category: Meals/Travel/Accommodation/Supplies | Attendees: Name1 (Company), Name2 (Company) | Purpose: [e.g., 'Customer X on-site demo / Redwood presence at BayCon 2026'] | Amount: $XXX | Card used: Corporate/Personal (last 4)."
- Reconcile any prepayments (swag, deposit). Attach vendor invoices and PO numbers if present.
- Fill out short postmortem note in #events: what worked, what failed, vendor ratings (1–5), any receipts that need manual approval.

Practical tips & gotchas (from previous runs):
- Hotels sometimes apply incidental holds ($200) on cards — advise teammates to use personal cards to avoid holds on corporate card if personal funds are limited. Note hold requires release ~7–14 days.
- Foreign transaction fees: corporate card reimburses FX fees only if marked on receipt; capture conversion rate screen.
- Meal tax rules differ by state — tag state in expense (CA, NY, TX).
- If vendor emails invoice as PDF with weird filename, rename to: vendorname_invoice_YYYYMMDD.pdf before upload.

Open items / questions to resolve:
- Do we have an approved alcohol budget for the welcome reception? (Asked finance on 2026-02-28, awaiting reply.)
- Confirm Ramp tag mapping for internal cost centers (cc: finance).

Mini checklists to copy into phone notes (short):
- [ ] Boarding pass + hotel code saved to phone calendar
- [ ] Photo receipts after every purchase
- [ ] Tag expenses with EVENTS-RED-2026 in Ramp
- [ ] Postmortem note in #events within 72h

Random small reminders:
- If you buy chargers/adapters: ask vendor for small receipt — otherwise write "adapter for AV setup" on memo.
- For client dinners, get everyone to write name on receipt so Finance doesn't ping.
- Keep one paper envelope for cash tips and scan the folded $ amounts into picture.

Contact escalation (if finance needs sign-off):
- First: Rita Gomez (events lead) — rita@redwood.ai — +1 415-555-0140
- Second: Alex Morgan (Finance manager) — alex.morgan@redwood.ai — +1 212-555-0111

End notes: this is a living scratchpad. Move things to Confluence page after event (link above). If anything comes up while on the road, ping me (Asha) or drop a note in #events-ops with subject "URGENT: conference".

Last edited by Asha on 2026-03-05 — TODO: reconcile receipts from Liam and confirm vendor final invoice.
